name: wardstral-8b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from mistralai/Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-05. wardstral-8b is a QLoRA (r=16, alpha=32, q/k/v/o_proj) finetune of mistralai/Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 merged back into full BF16 weights - 9 shards, 8.0198B params, so a merged model rather than a bare adapter (the separate adapter repo is ratnam1510/mistral-small-secure-scan). Trained 3 epochs / 156 steps on ~864 security-vulnerability examples (ratnam1510/security-vuln-dataset). flops_per_token_active = 2 * 8.02e9 = 1.604e10. KV 147456 B/token = 36 layers * 8 kv heads * 128 * 2 * 2, with only the 9 full-attention layers actually holding a full cache in practice (sliding layers are windowed). Licence: the card declares apache-2.0, while the base Ministral-8B-Instruct-2410 is under the Mistral Research License (non-production) - the derivative's own declaration is recorded, treat redistribution as unresolved. Evidence is a 20-sample LLM-as-judge eval (GLM-4.5-air), a 1-5 rubric, not a standard benchmark; n=20 and the fix-suggestion gain (+0.04) is noise.
